description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Area', which is responsible for rendering area charts in the PEAR PHP Image_Graph library. It includes methods for drawing legend samples and outputting the plot, handling stacked and non-stacked area charts.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Area
classes.description: Class for rendering area charts in the Image_Graph library, supporting stacked and non-stacked modes.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the area plot for the legend.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the area chart plot, handling stacking, drawing vertices, and finalizing the rendering.
